exclusion_detail: Lead 58 is made by Suzuki coupling (11a), Mitsunobu with phthalimide (13a), hydrazinolysis (14a), Buchwald-Hartwig with aryl halide 19 (35), then reductive amination with D-serine: 5 reactions, plus any preparation of aryl halide 19 ('purchased or synthesized as described in the Experimental Section').

lead.why: Abstract: 'compound 58 showed the most potent inhibitory activity and binding affinity with hPD-L1'.

notes: Every analogue in the series passes through the same 11 -> amine -> Buchwald -> reductive amination chain (5 steps), so no other compound qualifies.
